summary: Prevent bidirectional GitHub sync from reopening stale remote closures

delivery.outcome: Bidirectional GitHub sync observes inbound state before any outbound mutation and reloads the selected local snapshot after reconciliation.
nonGoals: No forced native blocked or terminal state changes
No bulk-read performance redesign or new dependencies

architecture.decision: Keep the existing sync orchestrator and adapter contracts; order its phases and reload through the existing scoped loader.
architecture.rollback: Revert only the bounded implementation change through its protected delivery process; preserve already reconciled operational ticket state.
